description: This file defines a PHP class 'FormatWithNull' that implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. The class provides a method 'getFormattedValue' that, regardless of input, returns null. It is part of a human resource management system's maintenance module, specifically within the purge strategy formatting strategy namespace.

classes.name: FormatWithNull
classes.description: A class implementing the 'ValueFormatter' interface, providing a method to always return null as the formatted value.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns null regardless of the input value. Implements the 'getFormattedValue' method from 'ValueFormatter' interface.
